title: scrumia-practice-tdd — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-practice-tdd: the ScrumIA practices slot — the TDD cycle situated for an agent, mock boundary, AC-to-test.
tagline: One named point of the implementation contract: how we test.
responsibilities: Refines a single question the implementation module leaves open — the red-green-refactor cycle operationalised for an agent, where the mock boundary sits, and how an acceptance criterion maps to a test that can actually fail.
refusals: It does not own the stack, the file structure or the design principles — and where it disagrees with the implementation module, the implementation module wins.
philosophy: Assumes a failing test is the cheapest specification you can write. Costs a slower first pass, paid back only if the code outlives the sprint that produced it.
